title: XIntelFeatureScoresV1
description: Prospective feature scores at detection time (T). Observable-at-T only — no hindsight. Provisional BATCH_01 shortlist for experiment_id=xintel_v0. Score on EVERY new candidate; null when unknown.

scored_by.description: Desk or agent that last wrote scores (e.g. Flow, Narrative, Outcome Desk aggregate).

scores.description: Keyed by feature_id. Every BATCH_01 shortlist id SHOULD appear; missing keys treated as unknown.

value.description: Typed score or null if unknown at T. Type depends on feature_id (see feature_catalog).

desk.description: Desk that usually fills this score: Flow | Narrative | Market | X Scout.

feature_catalog.description: Authoritative scoring rubrics for BATCH_01 provisional OOS shortlist. Not a runtime required field — documentation for desks.

D1.name: bundled_concentration
D1.scoring: true = sybil-bundled launch / funnel concentration observable at T (cluster tooling: many wallets buy at launch then re-aggregate). false = tooling checked and no material funnel concentration. null = tooling unavailable or inconclusive.
D1.notes_from_signals: SHAR Bubblemaps 60%/100+ wallets on death side. Requires cluster tooling at T0; invisible on naive holder UI. med–high confidence when tooling available.

S2.name: first_mint_in_window
S2.scoring: Relative to narrative family at T: first = credible first mint in news/meta window; early = among first wave; late_challenger = week+ late or explicit post-leader timing; unknown/null if family window unclear live.
S2.notes_from_signals: PNUT/MOODENG/GOAT runners; JUSTICE/GPT2/PESTO/SHAR/DORAE late or copycat. First is hard to know live amid CA spam. med confidence.

S3.name: lore_native_amplifier
S3.scoring: true = amplification from a non-generic attention node observable at T (lore-native agent endorsement, news/political node, multi-outlet animal virality) — not only paid KOL blasts. false = only generic/paid blasts observed. null = unknown.
S3.notes_from_signals: GOAT ToT; PNUT Vance/Musk; MOODENG global media. SHAR paid multi-KOL opposite. Amplifiers can exit liquidity; presence ≠ safety. med confidence.

S4.name: time_alive_before_parabola
S4.scoring: Age/survival band observable at first_seen (pair age / time since mint). Not a prediction of future grind — only elapsed life at T. minutes|hours = short-lived so far; days|weeks_plus = multi-day survival before any major expansion observed at T.
S4.notes_from_signals: Runners often multi-day/week before parabolic print; deaths often minutes/hours. Slow grind can still rug; speed alone ≠ quality. med confidence.

D2.name: post_leader_copycat
D2.scoring: true = explicit copycat timing / cohort membership after a category leader already printed (same narrative family, late challenger). false = not a post-leader copycat (original lane or unrelated hitch). null = unclear.
D2.notes_from_signals: GPT2/PESTO/JUSTICE/DORAE death hits. Some copycats still run (not in BATCH_01). med confidence.

S5.name: lp_mint_cto_custody
S5.scoring: true = at least one verifiable structural custody claim visible at T: LP burn, mint revoke, full-float narrative with on-chain support, or successful CTO removing hostile deployer. false = checked and none present. null = not verified. Weak alone — do not treat as a switch.
S5.notes_from_signals: WIF/POPCAT runners; many burned-LP tokens still die on attention death. Need on-chain verify live. low–med; weak alone.

D4.name: early_ca_migration
D4.scoring: true = contract migration / new CA within days of launch observable at T (or announced migration in flight). false = continuity of main CA confirmed at T. null = unknown.
D4.notes_from_signals: JUSTICE → JFP ~10 days on death side. Migrations sometimes honest; coincided with collapse narrative in batch. med confidence.

S1.name: cultural_prior
S1.scoring: true = pre-existing cultural object (years-old meme, breaking-news animal, agent lore) existed before mint and is tightly matched to ticker — use as prior not as switch. false = new brand / generic / no prior fit. null = unknown. Selection-biased in Historian batch.
S1.notes_from_signals: 5/5 runners had priors; many prior-backed tokens still die. Survivorship in case selection. med; biased — prior not switch.
